Facts: Hunan province. Defendant Fu (付某某) is a drug user, previously administrative detention. He suspects his wife (邹某) has improper relationship with Xiao2 (肖某2). Fu drives car, picks up Xiao2 near court, drives to Shiqiao township government, meets with Fu Shao etc. They beat Xiao2, causing injuries: head, hand, right 5th metacarpal fracture, constituting light injury (轻伤二级). Then at 19:00, they take Xiao2 to hotel room. To damage Xiao2's image, make Zou dislike Xiao2, to cut off their relationship, Fu forces Xiao2 to take methamphetamine (甲基苯丙胺片剂, "麻古"), Fu Shao takes photos. Xiao2 writes a guarantee not to contact Zou, and writes a 500,000 yuan IOU. Then Fu sends Xiao2 home. Next day Xiao2 reports to police, urine test positive for meth. Fu later surrenders. Compensation agreement.

They didn't mention restraining him, but they forced him to take drugs. The main crimes: intentional injury, forced drug use.

However the facts: they forced him to sign guarantee not to contact his wife and a 50万元欠条. That could be considered "敲诈勒索". The typical crime: "敲诈勒索罪" is extorting property by threatening.
